metadata.title: Prodigia for schools
metadata.description: Bring Prodigia's adaptive practice to your whole classroom, with real progress tracking for every student.

hero.titulo: Adaptive practice for your whole classroom
hero.subtitulo: Mental math, logic, geography, chemistry, anatomy, music theory, trigonometry and history — with difficulty that adjusts to each student, plus duels that keep them coming back.

mundos.descripcion: Every world calibrates its own level per student — nobody gets bored going too slow, or frustrated going too fast.

adaptativo.descripcion: Each student's level goes up and down on its own, based on how they're doing — not one fixed difficulty for the whole class.

gamificado.descripcion: Streaks, achievements, Chispas and cosmetics — the same mechanics that get a student to open the app without being told to.

duelos.descripcion: Friendly competition between classmates, with ranking and rank — practice turns into a game, not homework.

seguimiento.descripcion: Accuracy, playtime and activity by topic — not just whether they logged in, but how they're actually doing.

estadisticas.descripcion: Every Pro account already has its own stats panel: accuracy by city, playtime and daily activity, with simple, easy-to-read charts.
estadisticas.piloto: We're opening a pilot for schools that want a full-classroom view, combining all their students into one panel for the teacher. Tell us about your school and we'll let you know as soon as it's ready.

precio.descripcion: Pricing depends on your school's size and whether your students already have their own accounts. Write to us and we'll send you a quote.

metadata.title: Privacy — Prodigia
metadata.description: What data Prodigia stores and what it's used for.

privacidad.intro: We're a small education app — this explains in plain language what we store and why.
privacidad.datosEmail: Your email (if you created an account with email and password).
privacidad.datosPerfil: Your display name, your profile photo (avatar) if you uploaded one, and your progress: level by world and by topic, streak, Chispas, Experience, achievements, and titles.
privacidad.datosActividad: Your practice activity: what you answered, whether you got it right, how long it took — this is what we use to calibrate difficulty to your level.
privacidad.datosDuelos: Your real-time duel history: who you played against, the result, and how your ELO moved.
privacidad.datosClan: If you're part of a clan: which one, your role there, and the messages you send in the clan chat (visible only to the rest of your clan).
privacidad.datosAmistades: Your friendships within the app (who you added, who added you).
privacidad.datosGrupo: If you're part of a teacher's group, that teacher can see your group's aggregate progress (level, streak, accuracy), never your individual answers beyond that.
privacidad.datosEdad: Your age, if you entered it — asked once, right after you create your account, only to know whether you can enter the Backroom (14 and up). We don't use it for anything else.
privacidad.datosPago: If you bought Chispas or Prodigia Pro: what you bought, when, and your subscription status. Your card number and payment details themselves are received and processed directly by Mercado Pago or Paddle (see below) — they never pass through our servers and we never store them.
privacidad.datosDocente: If you filled out the Prodigia for schools form: the school's name, your name, your email, your phone, and any message you wrote — used only to respond to that inquiry, it's separate from any student account.
privacidad.usoTexto: Only to make the app work: calibrating your level, calculating your progress, showing the ranking, the feed, and your clan's chat, processing your purchases if you make any, and nothing else. We don't sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising purposes. Clan chat has an automatic filter for offensive language (a message that contains it is rejected before it's saved), and any message can be reported for manual review — there's no automatic content moderation beyond that filter.
privacidad.tercerosTexto: We use a handful of providers to make Prodigia work, each gets only what it needs for its part: Supabase hosts the database, authentication, and file storage (avatars, profile backgrounds); Mercado Pago and Paddle process payments (Paddle also acts as the merchant of record for purchases outside Colombia, so the invoice comes from Paddle, not Prodigia directly); Brevo sends account emails (confirmation, password reset). None of these use your data for their own advertising or resell it — they only have it to provide us that one specific service.
privacidad.menoresTexto: Prodigia can be used by school-age kids. We ask for the minimum amount of data from any user, minor or not, and the one specific age question (see above) exists only to gate the Backroom for under-14s, not to build a profile on that person. If you're a parent or guardian and want to review or delete a minor's data, you can delete the account yourself from the profile (see below) or write to us.
privacidad.borrarTexto: From <link>your profile</link> you can delete your account completely — your progress, achievements, title, duel history, clan membership, chat messages, friendships, your Chispas and Pro subscription if you had one, and everything else tied to your account gets erased permanently. One exception to keep in mind: if you played a duel against someone else and that person later deletes their account, the record of that duel may also disappear from your own history — that's not something you can prevent, it's a side effect of how the other account's data gets deleted.

metadata.title: Terms of use — Prodigia
metadata.description: Prodigia's terms of use, in plain language.

terminos.intro: This is written in plain language on purpose — it's not a complex legal contract, it's an honest explanation of what Prodigia is and how it works.
terminos.queEsTexto: Prodigia is an adaptive practice education app: mental math, logic, geography, chemistry, anatomy, music theory, and other topics that keep getting added, with difficulty that adjusts to how you're doing. It also includes real-time duels against other players (with ELO and rank), clans, friends, achievements, and a social feed. It doesn't replace a class or a formal assessment — it's a practice tool.
terminos.cuentaTexto: You can create an account with email and password, or sign in as a guest and decide later if you want to save it. You're responsible for keeping your password secure.
terminos.usoTexto: Use Prodigia to practice in good faith. Don't try to manipulate the Chispas system, the ranking, or duels with bots, scripts, or automated responses. In your clan chat and anywhere else you can write free text, don't use offensive, discriminatory, or abusive language — messages that contain it are automatically rejected before being saved, and any message or profile can be reported for manual review.
terminos.edadTexto: Prodigia is built to be usable from school age, with or without adult supervision. Some sections have their own age limit: the Backroom (casino-style minigames, always played with in-game Chispas, never real money) is for users 14 and up only — we ask your age once, right after you create your account, only to apply that one limit, never for anything else. If you're a parent or guardian and want a minor's account deleted, you can do it yourself from <linkPerfil>their profile</linkPerfil> or write to us.
terminos.proTexto: Prodigia Pro is an optional subscription (monthly or annual) that grants extra Chispas every month, exclusive cosmetics, and other perks shown on <linkPro>the Pro page</linkPro> before you subscribe. It's charged upfront and renews automatically at the end of each period until you cancel — cancellation happens through your Mercado Pago (Colombia) or Paddle (rest of the world) account, the processors that handle the actual charge; Prodigia never sees or stores your card number. If you cancel, you keep Pro until the end of the period you already paid for, with no refund for that period unless your local law requires otherwise. We may change Pro's price or perks going forward, never retroactively on a period you already paid for.
terminos.chispasTexto: Chispas are the game's currency: most are earned by playing, and some can also be bought with real money in fixed packs. They have no cash value, can't be transferred to another account or withdrawn as money, and purchases aren't refundable once credited, unless your local law requires otherwise. If you delete your account, you lose any Chispas and active Pro benefits at that moment, with no refund — that's why <linkPerfil>deleting your account</linkPerfil> warns you about this before you confirm.
terminos.docentesTexto: If you fill out the <linkDocentes>Prodigia for schools</linkDocentes> form, we use that information (school name, your name, email, phone, and anything else you add) only to respond to your inquiry — it doesn't create or change any student account. An actual agreement with a school (licenses, student accounts, what data teachers would see) is defined separately, in writing, before it goes live.
terminos.borrarTexto: You can delete your account anytime from <link>your profile</link>. That action is permanent: it deletes your progress, achievements, duel history, clan membership, chat messages, Chispas and Pro subscription if you had one, and everything else tied to your account — it can't be undone and nothing already paid is refunded. If you played a duel against someone who later deletes their account, that duel may also disappear from your own history — it's a side effect of how deletion works, not something you can prevent on the other end.
